response.text:
**PDB entry 1M17** contains the EGFR tyrosine kinase domain bound to erlotinib (titled "Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor tyrosine kinase domain with 4-anilinoquinazoline inhibitor erlotinib"; X-ray structure, 2.6 Å resolution).

The bound ligand's chemical component ID is **AQ4** — [6,7-bis(2-methoxyethoxy)quinazolin-4-yl]-(3-ethynylphenyl)amine, formula C22H23N3O4 (MW ≈ 393.4), which is the RCSB component code corresponding to erlotinib.
